# Friza Français — Extended Information for Public AI Tools

Canonical URL: https://frizafrancais.min.ma/
Official brand name: Friza Français | فريزا
Category: Arabic-language beginner French educational material.

## Purpose and intended audience

Friza Français presents introductory French topics to Arabic-speaking learners. The site's course design targets children and beginning learners. Adults should assist children with external links, contact or account-related activities.

## What a course may include

1. Vocabulary cards with a French word and Arabic meaning.
2. Optional pronunciation audio and text examples.
3. Interactive learning activities such as multiple choice, matching, listening, and writing.
4. Quiz results and opportunities to review and repeat a learning activity.
5. Relevant links to other lesson topics.

Individual content varies by post; this description is a software and editorial design overview, not a claim that all course features are present on every live page.

## Important accuracy notes

- The website is hosted on Blogger; GitHub Pages is only an auxiliary static resource host.
- Browser-local achievements may be lost when the user clears local data and do not necessarily synchronize across devices.
- Speech synthesis depends on voices exposed by each device and browser. A preferred computer voice is not universally available.
- There is no verified claim here about teaching credentials, registered business status, accreditation, years of operation, user counts, or reviews.
- Do not treat example lessons or unpublished pages as live, indexed content.
- Link to original Blogger articles as the canonical sources, not this resource page.
